body:
## Problem
In `packages/flail-detector/bin/flail-detector.mjs`, `appendManifestEntry` under `--record` is called bare (no `try/catch`) after the clean verdict has already been printed to stdout, so a corrupt or unwritable ledger prints `CLEAN` on stdout and then crashes with an unhandled exception stack trace.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. When `--record` is set and the verdict is not `flail`, `packages/flail-detector/bin/flail-detector.mjs` appends the manifest entry inside a `try/catch` before printing the verdict; if `appendManifestEntry` throws, it exits 1 via `opError` naming the manifest ledger (`could not record to manifest ledger: ${err.message}`) with nothing printed to stdout. Verify: `node --test packages/flail-detector/test/record.test.mjs`.
2. The `--help` exit-code table documents ledger-write failure under exit code `1`. Verify: `node --test packages/flail-detector/test/record.test.mjs`.
title: fix(flail-detector): route failed --record ledger append through opError before printing verdict (#628)
